meta.description: 200-customer 30new dataset: 75% kept from 200.30.1, 25% OSM points in 20x20 to 30x30 mile ring

filtered_30km_500m.rule: Keep only customers with OSRM depot->point < 30000 m and point->depot < 30000 m; final selected points satisfy directed OSRM pair distance >= 500 m.

meta.selection_rule: Remove 1/4 customers from the current 30-mile dataset and replace them with OSM POIs inside the 30x30 mile square but outside the 20x20 mile square.

theta_one_replacement.rule: For theta_ijl == 1.00, sample Uniform(min_l,max_l) from source pairs i,j in 1..100 with same l and theta != 1.00, rounded to 2 decimals.

meta.truck_distance_rule: Existing-existing edges are sliced from the current 30-mile matrix; any edge involving an OSM point uses OSRM table when USE_OSRM_FOR_OSM_EDGES=true, otherwise Euclidean distance multiplied by the median road/euclidean factor from the current 30-mile matrix.
meta.vmax_rule: Existing-existing edges are sliced from the current 30-mile file; any edge involving an OSM point is sampled from the current 30-mile empirical vmax distribution.
meta.theta_rule: Existing-existing edges are sliced from the current 30-mile file; any edge involving an OSM point uses heavy theta=round(Uniform(0.9,1.0)*base_L[l],2).
